**Ludora - the Client for all Game Clients** · Release 0.7.3

### What's new
- Ludora now lives at **[github.com/Moxyboxyy/ludora](https://github.com/Moxyboxyy/ludora)**. Updates are fetched from the new address; nothing changes for you.

Everything from 0.7.2 (“Runs on …” filter, streaming from your other devices) is included – see the [0.7.2 release](https://github.com/Moxyboxyy/ludora/releases/tag/v0.7.2).

### Downloads
| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `Ludora-Setup-0.7.3.exe` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon M1–M4) | `Ludora-0.7.3-arm64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| macOS (Intel) | `Ludora-0.7.3-x64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| Linux (any distribution) | `Ludora-0.7.3-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `Ludora-0.7.3-amd64.deb` |

The files are not code-signed: on Windows click **More info → Run anyway**, on macOS **right-click → Open** on the first start.
[Installation](https://github.com/Moxyboxyy/ludora#installation) · [Anleitung auf Deutsch](https://github.com/Moxyboxyy/ludora/blob/main/README.de.md#installation)
